title: IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 is affected by an information disclosure…
description: IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty versions 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 contain an information disclosure vulnerability. This flaw arises from unsafe class reflection in the JMX REST connector body parser, potentially allowing unauthorized information exposure. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3.
